links.outcome: Readability (FKRGL, FRE) of ChatGPT-4o responses to patient perioperative questions
links.effect: Mean FKRGL 14.51 (SD 1.86), range 10.8 to 18.1; mean FRE 28.8 (SD 9.87), indicating college-level, low readability.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o–generated responses read at an average FKRGL of 14.51 (SD 1.86), requiring some level of college education for adequate comprehension.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of responses with prompting to 5th-grade level versus original or rephrased questions
links.effect: Median FKRGL fell from 15.6 to 7.1 with 5th-grade prompting; rephrasing only reduced it to 14.5. Content similarity was 3.88/5 (prompting) and 4.63/5 (rephrasing).
links.quote: When GPT-4o was queried to respond to select questions to the level of a 5th-grade reader, the median FKRGL score decreased to 7.1 (IQR 6.1-8.3) and FRE increased to 73.8 (IQR 66.6-79.3; range: 60.1‐80.9).

links.outcome: Readability and content similarity of responses to paraphrased questions at 5th-grade level versus explicit prompting
links.effect: Rephrased questions gave median FKRGL 14.5 versus 15.6 original, a less meaningful drop. Content similarity to the original was 4.63 for rephrasing and 3.88 for prompting.
links.quote: Notably, there was a less meaningful drop in median FKRGL score, from 15.6 (IQR 14.4-16.7) to 14.5 (IQR 13.2-15.4), when ChatGPT was used to rephrase questions to be asked at the reading level of a 5th grader.

links.outcome: Expert-reported inaccuracies and content gaps in ChatGPT-4o cancer surgery responses
links.effect: Surgeons reported numerous inaccuracies and content gaps, for example mislabeling rectal bleeding as systemic, wrong timing of light activities, missing major hepatectomy, and missing genetic testing. Staging and treatment accuracy averaged 3.29/5.
links.quote: Numerous inaccuracies within GPT-generated responses were detected by a surgeon-expert concerning general disease information and postoperative recovery.

links.effect: Mean accuracy 3.57/5 (SD 0.34); staging/treatment 3.29 (SD 0.38); numerous inaccuracies and gaps.
links.quote: However, numerous inaccuracies and content gaps were identified within responses.

links.effect: Rephrased 5th-grade questions had mean content similarity 4.63 (SD 0.25) to original responses.
links.quote: Responses to questions that were rephrased by GPT, with prompting to query at a 5th-grade reading level, resulted in a median FKRGL score of 14.5 (IQR 13.2-15.4; range: 11.6 to 15.8), a median FRE score of 32.0 (IQR 27.0-37.7; range: 21.4‐45.0), and a mean content similarity of 4.63 (SD 0.25) to original responses.
